Subject: The Stormline Shell: built for the days that don't clear up
CTA: Shop the Stormline Shell -> https://www.northbaysupply.com/products/NB-JKT-07
Body: Some trips don't go according to plan — the front moves in faster, the ridge takes longer, the drizzle turns into something more serious.

The Northbay Stormline Shell (NB-JKT-07) is built for those days.

Here's what it does:

• **20,000mm waterproof rating** — keeps water out under sustained rain, not just a passing shower.
• **20,000 g/m²/24hr breathability** — moves sweat vapor out while you're working uphill, so you're not soaked from the inside.
• **3-layer laminate construction** — the face fabric, membrane, and liner are bonded together, which keeps the jacket performing trip after trip without the membrane shifting or bunching.
• **420g** — light enough to carry on routes where weight matters, substantial enough to be your primary layer in real rain.

A few honest notes: the Stormline is a shell. It's not insulated, so you'll layer underneath in cold conditions. It's built for trail and alpine use — not technical climbing where you need a helmet-compatible hood with specific geometry.

If your next trip has rain in the forecast and you need a jacket that does its job without fuss, this is a straightforward choice.
